# @ankh-morpork/watch

Patrols, arrests and reports for the Ankh-Morpork City Watch.

## Install

```sh
npm install @ankh-morpork/watch
```

## Usage

```js
import { patrol, arrest } from "@ankh-morpork/watch";

const report = await patrol("Treacle Mine Road", { officers: 2 });
```

## Night patrols

Pass `night: true` and the patrol reports over the clacks to Pseudopolis Yard.
A night patrol needs at least two officers; with one, `patrol` rejects.

## The rota

`duty(post)` from `@ankh-morpork/watch/rota` returns who is on duty at a post.
